# MidAmerica Basement Systems

> > MidAmerica Basement Systems provides basement waterproofing, foundation repair, crawl space encapsulation, concrete leveling with PolyLevel, and radon mitigation services across Iowa and Illinois, serving Davenport, Cedar Rapids, Peoria, and the Quad Cities area.

MidAmerica Basement Systems specializes in comprehensive home foundation and moisture control solutions using proprietary products like CleanSpace Vapor Barrier, ThermalDry systems, and PolyLevel injection technology. The company serves residential and commercial clients throughout Iowa and Illinois with EPA-compliant radon services and complete basement finishing solutions.

## Key Topics

- Basement Waterproofing
- PolyLevel Concrete Lifting
- Foundation Repair
- Crawl Space Encapsulation
- Radon Mitigation
- CleanSpace Vapor Barrier
- ThermalDry Vapor Barrier
- Sump Pump Installation
- Drainage Solutions
- Concrete Repair & Leveling
- Foamax Wall Panel System
- Dehumidifier Systems
- Water Damage Prevention
- NexusPro Sealant
- Egress Windows
